promptTemplate: A production asset sheet of TWO separate wide photographic still-life arrangements, top and bottom, for a premium British vegetable growing book. {description} Wide landscape canvas, approximately 3:2. Each row fills nearly the full width, flattened panoramic composition 3:1 width-to-height, with natural overlapping crops forming a single coherent arrangement. Same scale of produce in both rows. Rows entirely separated by ample transparent empty space across the exact middle at 50% height. Every leaf, root and tendril ends naturally INSIDE the frame on all four sides, 4% clear padding. Photoreal fresh harvest, clear natural skin, smooth clean professional studio photography, restrained natural markings, no speckles or synthetic dot texture, no sprinkled dirt or water droplets. Overhead diffuse light from upper left, natural internal modelling and gentle contact shadows. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere behind vegetables. No surface, props, borders, text, title, stickers, graphics or background.

arrangements.name: 01 · Original harvest
arrangements.description: Top: a small truss of ripe red and amber tomatoes at left, one whole red onion and a cut half showing concentric rings at centre, two pea pods (one open) with a delicate tendril to the right. Bottom: two long orange carrots with airy, intact tops on the left, a fan of fresh purple-stemmed curly kale on the right.

arrangements.name: 02 · Summer greenhouse
arrangements.description: Top: an aubergine with a glossy purple flank at left, a yellow and a red sweet pepper, one pepper sliced open to reveal its cream seed core. Bottom: two dark green courgettes lying diagonally with one gold flower attached, a small loose group of red tomatoes at right.

arrangements.name: 03 · Kitchen roots
arrangements.description: Top: three deep crimson beetroots with short wine-coloured stems and one sliced beet face, arranged in a sweeping diagonal, beside a few golden shallots. Bottom: a pair of cream parsnips with elegant tapered roots crossing gently, alongside pink-topped white turnips with a few sage-green leaves.

arrangements.name: 04 · Pods and salad
arrangements.description: Top: overlapping broad bean pods with one split to reveal pale beans on white felt, and a few slender purple and green French beans in a sweep. Bottom: folded butterhead lettuce at left and a loose bunch of bright scarlet radishes on the right with lively natural leaves.

arrangements.name: 05 · Autumn harvest
arrangements.description: Top: one small squat ribbed orange pumpkin and an overlapping wedge of pumpkin turned towards camera, beside a few small russet potatoes. Bottom: a sweeping pair of leeks across the left side, a cluster of freshly lifted garlic bulbs with a loosened clove to the right.

arrangements.name: 06 · Brassica colours
arrangements.description: Top: a deep purple red cabbage half displaying its ivory marbling beside several broccoli florets in a gently interlocking cluster. Bottom: a pale cauliflower head breaking through curled leaves left of centre with three orange carrots, one crossing its companions towards the right.

arrangements.name: 07 · Corn and chard
arrangements.description: Top: two golden sweetcorn cobs with soft folded-back green husks, sweeping diagonally beside two sun-ripened red tomatoes. Bottom: a fan of red and gold-stemmed chard displaying red, gold and green arcs, with one red onion and a cut onion half at right.
